subject: english
title: Vocabulary 2
subtitle: Action Words — put, turn, lift, move, use: the five verbs for giving instructions, taught around the hula hoop.

content: Identify and use action words to give instructions.
Complete the hula hoop instructions in Student Book p. 122, Activity 1.
Put the TR 7.7 action words in the order they are heard (Activity 2).
language: Produce and use the five target words: put, turn, lift, move, use.
Give an instruction with the base form of the verb and no subject.
Explain why the hoop turns takes -s while you turn does not.
Use the sequence words first, next, then, and finally.
